question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Beat about the bush

options.text: Avoid talking about the main topic

solution:
The correct answer is **'Avoid talking about the main topic**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase** "Beat about the bush"** best expresses:* 'Avoid talking about the main topic'.*
